about: Every resume of the route from a chapter save finishes, except these halts (tools/resume_check.py; docs/campaign/CAMPAIGN_RUNNER.md#the-runner). Each entry is one halt, where it stops (chapter, objective index, halt kind), the chapters whose resume reaches it, the issue that owns it and the date it was recorded. An unlisted halt fails the check, and so does a listed resume that no longer halts there.
